purpose: Export authoritative user-owned Brain state into an inspectable provider-neutral bundle and restore it into a clean workspace location.
rules: The local user-owned workspace remains authoritative.
Export and restore must not depend on any semantic-memory provider, Git remote, or hosting service.
An export is a local portable copy, not evidence of replicated backup.
Pending Aham mutations, migrations, or external-source activations must be resolved before export.
Portable payload paths must not collide after Unicode normalization and case folding.
Session authority is restore-local and must be freshly issued rather than copied.
Restore must verify every manifest digest before creating the final destination.
Restore must not overwrite a non-empty destination.
